mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role (code, name, scope, builtin, create_at, update_at, create_by, update_by, deleted) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{scope}, #{builtin}, now(), now(), 'system', 'system', FALSE)
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_role SET name = #{name}, update_at = now() WHERE code = #{code} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE sys_role SET deleted = TRUE, update_at = now() WHERE code = #{code}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_role_permission (role_code, permission, create_at, create_by) VALUES (#{roleCode}, #{permission}, now(), 'system') ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_member WHERE role_code = #{roleCode} AND deleted = FALSE
